facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Describes itself as AI agent infrastructure 'for teams building agents that need to access real-time information, execute tasks securely, and deliver real-world outcomes'.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Three products: Search (real-time, source-backed web data), ScaleBox (secure sandboxes for code, files and workflows) and Agent API (a managed agent layer).

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Search combines SmartSearch (live source discovery) and Reader (structured extraction from pages, PDFs, images and rich media), in 30+ languages.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: ScaleBox is 'globally distributed sandbox infrastructure purpose-built for AI agents': isolated environments to run agent-written code, process files, call tools and external APIs, with usage visibility and workload-based control.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Agent API composes Search and ScaleBox with planning, thread-based memory, multi-file processing, streaming of search steps and tool calls, and structured deliverables (reports, tables, charts, JSON, files).

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: Agent API is for SaaS companies, vertical software teams (finance, legal, retail, healthcare, manufacturing), startups and solution providers delivering agent workflows to enterprises.

facts.label: From their own pages
facts.fact: The site publishes machine-readable product context for agents (llms.txt and Markdown twins of its pages).

told: The swarm's workflow was run live on Cloudsway at the summit, and it worked.
Both sides are exploring an API and billing partnership.
domain_note: No domain was given. cloudsway.ai ('Cloudsway | AI Agent Infrastructure'; cloudsway.com redirects to it) matches. Not yet confirmed by the company.

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: Cloudsway gives agents reach: live web data, sandboxes that run their code and call external APIs, and a managed agent that plans and uses tools. RiskMandate measures that reach against what each agent was asked to do. Together: agents built on Cloudsway that carry a written mandate and a measured record of what they could reach.

mandate.text: Agent API returns a deliverable for a task: the task is the mandate. Streaming of search steps and tool calls makes it observable.

reach.text: ScaleBox sandboxes can run agent-written code and call tools and external APIs; Search reaches the open web. What a sandbox's network and credentials can reach per tenant is not stated on the public pages.

gap.text: Unknown from public pages. The sandbox is where the gap is measurable: one sandbox, one policy, the reach recorded, as in our own harness runs.

together.label: Our suggestions. Nothing here is agreed.
